feedback.problem: Consider a linear transformation $T:{R}^{4}\to {R}^{4}.$ If $\text{rank}(T)=4$ then $\text{nullity}(T)=$
feedback.worked_solution:
According to the rank-nullity theorem, if $T:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n},$ then

$$
\text{rank}(T)+\text{nullity}(T)=n.
$$

For the given transformation, we have $n=4.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(T)+\text{nullity}(T) & =n \\ 4+\text{nullity}(T) & =4 \\ \text{nullity}(T) & =4-4 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
